nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 7: shared publish path. Both callers build this normalized session-result contract: the SYNC orchestrator (from Call Execute Agent Session + Call Assemble Context + Resolve Lane) and the ASYNC Session Waiter Finish webhook (from the waiter finish payload + locally-computed doc_files/usd_cost). Cost logging (Log Model Run) happens in the CALLER before this, so Sum Execution Image Cost / Write Cost Field see the session cost row.

nodes.name: Normalize Input
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 7: parse the flat contract into the shape the moved post-path nodes expect. Field names are IDENTICAL to the orchestrator refs they replaced (output_blocks/doc_files arrays, image_blocks_json, since_ts, etc.) so the copied nodes needed only their $(caller-node) refs repointed here. output_blocks/doc_files are parsed from their _json strings; delivered_via_tool is coerced to a real boolean (the Session OK? gate does === true).

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json || {};
function arr(v){ if (Array.isArray(v)) return v; if (typeof v === "string"){ try { const p = JSON.parse(v||"[]"); return Array.isArray(p)?p:[]; } catch(e){ return []; } } return []; }
const dvt = (j.delivered_via_tool === true || j.delivered_via_tool === "true" || j.delivered_via_tool === 1 || j.delivered_via_tool === "1");
return [{ json: {
  outcome: j.outcome || "",
  delivered_via_tool: dvt,
  output_message: j.output_message || "",
  output_blocks: arr(j.output_blocks_json),
  doc_files: arr(j.doc_files_json),
  model_used: j.model_used || "",
  cost_pln: (j.cost_pln === "" || j.cost_pln == null) ? null : Number(j.cost_pln),
  session_id: j.session_id || "",
  status: j.status || "",
  duration_seconds: (j.duration_seconds === "" || j.duration_seconds == null) ? null : Number(j.duration_seconds),
  clickup_task_id: j.clickup_task_id || "",
  reviewer_user_id: j.reviewer_user_id || "",
  triggering_comment_id: j.triggering_comment_id || "",
  surface: j.surface || "task",
  surface_ref: j.surface_ref || "",
  image_blocks_json: j.input_image_refs_json || "[]",
  since_ts: j.since_ts || "",
  web_sources: j.web_sources || "[]"
} }];

nodes.name: Session OK?
nodes.notes: ADR-069/ADR-068/ADR-066 Block 1 fail-loud guard: gates on the PUBLISHABLE-ANSWER test, not text presence. TRUE = (delivered_via_tool AND (output_blocks non-empty OR doc_files non-empty)) OR (outcome==='done' AND output_message non-empty). ADR-069 (2026-07-02): a DOCUMENT-ONLY delivery — delivered_via_tool with EMPTY text blocks but a produced office-doc in doc_files (e.g. a .pptx) — now counts as delivered; previously it fell to FALSE and posted a false 'nie dostarczyl wyniku (timeout)' notice + CRITICAL non-delivery alert and dropped the deck. Non-delivery outcomes (deadline/terminated/max_rounds/poll_error/send_failed/create_failed) stay FALSE (delivered_via_tool is false there), so mid-work narration is NEVER posted as the answer. FALSE -> Call Post Reply (Incomplete) (Polish failure notice; flips status off 'W trakcie') + Alert Non-Delivery (CRITICAL).

nodes.name: Skip Cost If Chat?
nodes.notes: ADR-068: the cumulative CU '[AI] Koszt akcji' field write is task-bound. surface=='chat' (true) -> skip Call Write Cost Field, go straight to Sum Execution Image Cost; task (false) -> Call Write Cost Field (unchanged). Reads surface off the surface-agnostic Call Assemble Context (Merge).

nodes.name: Call Write Cost Field
nodes.notes: Managed lane cost write-back (parity with the bare lane's in-workflow field write). Sums agent_runs.cost_pln for the task and writes CU '[AI] Koszt akcji [PLN]'; returns {total} used for the comment footer. Runs AFTER the session logged its cost row so the SUM includes it. onError=continueRegularOutput + the sub-workflow is internally fail-soft, so a cost-sync hiccup never blocks Post Reply. NOTE: managed image-gen cost rows now carry the real clickup_task_id (agent-supplied tool arg, ADR-057 amendment) so they ARE included in this cumulative per-task SUM. The PER-EXECUTION image cost for the comment footer is computed separately by the downstream Sum Execution Image Cost node (windowed by since_ts, ADR-060) — this SUM stays the all-time task total for the CU field.

nodes.name: Sum Execution Image Cost
nodes.notes: ADR-060: per-execution image cost for the managed footer. SUMs agent_runs.cost_pln for THIS task over the managed image-gen rows (triggered_by='image_mcp', migration 036) created since Resolve Lane's since_ts (captured before the session ran), i.e. only THIS execution's images. Feeds Call Post Reply (Managed).total_image_cost_pln so the footer = session text cost + this run's images. Cumulative CU field (Write Cost Field, by task, all-time) is unchanged. onError=continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so a transient DB miss falls back to image_total 0 (Build/Post still run). Known limit: two concurrent runs on the SAME task overlap windows and can cross-count (rare; ADR-060).

parameters.query:
select coalesce(sum(cost_pln), 0) as image_total, count(*) as image_count
from agent_runs
where clickup_task_id = $1
  and triggered_by = 'image_mcp'
  and created_at >= coalesce(nullif($2, '')::timestamptz, now());

nodes.name: Img Cost Missing?
nodes.notes: ADR-060 reliability guard: TRUE when images WERE delivered this execution (render image_manifest non-empty) but the windowed image cost summed to 0 -> the per-execution image cost (footer + this-run attribution) is understated. Causes not already caught by the generation-time image-mcp/missing-task-id WARN: clock skew on since_ts, a triggered_by/filter mismatch, or all image rows landing null-task. Side branch -> Alert Image Cost Missing (WARN), never blocks Post Reply.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (function(){ const m = $('Call Render Agent Output').first().json.image_manifest; const a = Array.isArray(m) ? m : (function(){ try { return JSON.parse(m || '[]'); } catch(e){ return []; } })(); return a.length; })() }}

nodes.name: Alert Image Cost Missing
nodes.notes: ADR-060 WARN via Post Alert (v1): images were delivered in the comment but no per-execution image cost was attributed (footer/this-run cost understated). Complements the generation-time image-mcp/missing-task-id WARN by catching the since_ts-window/skew/filter failure modes. onError=continueRegularOutput so the alert can't break the run.

nodes.name: Call Post Reply (Incomplete)
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 1 (2026-06-30): on a non-delivery outcome, post a Polish incomplete-status notice via Post Reply (v1) and flip status off 'W trakcie' (Set Status Zakonczono). The failure text is set in BOTH rendered_delta (task surface -> Pass Delta) and completion (chat surface -> Build Chat Markdown, which ignores rendered_delta), and surface/surface_ref are passed, so a chat non-delivery is delivered to chat. NEVER renders output_message (the abandoned-session narration). image/doc fields empty; cost footer reflects the wasted spend.

nodes.name: Alert Non-Delivery
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 1 (2026-06-30): repurposed from 'Alert Session Empty'. CRITICAL when the managed session returned a NON-publishable outcome (deadline/terminated/max_rounds/poll_error/send_failed/create_failed). The orchestrator posts a Polish incomplete-status notice via Call Post Reply (Incomplete); this alert tells the operator (task, outcome, status, duration). onError=continueRegularOutput so the alert can't break the run.
